get.description: Set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (Claude Code) or `COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` with `COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` (Copilot CLI) to `<host>/gateway/anthropic`. Forwards `v1/messages`, `v1/messages/count_tokens` and `v1/models`; bodies and streams pass through unchanged. The client's key is forwarded, never stored.
get.summary: Anthropic API, proxied (Claude Code, Copilot CLI)

post.description: Set `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` (Claude Code) or `COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL` with `COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE=anthropic` (Copilot CLI) to `<host>/gateway/anthropic`. Forwards `v1/messages`, `v1/messages/count_tokens` and `v1/models`; bodies and streams pass through unchanged. The client's key is forwarded, never stored.
post.summary: Anthropic API, proxied (Claude Code, Copilot CLI)

get.description: Use `<host>/gateway/openai/v1` as the OpenAI-compatible base URL. Forwards `v1/chat/completions` and `v1/models`; bodies and streams pass through unchanged.
